headline: Kyrgyzstan wants to introduce a visa-free regime for another 18 countries
summary: Kyrgyzstan is proposing a visa-free regime for citizens of 18 more states and extending the allowed visa-free stay for foreigners from 30 to 60 days.
why: Visa policy shapes cross-border tourism and travel spending, which affects hospitality and transport demand in the country.
original_headline: Кыргызстан хочет ввести безвизовый режим еще для 18 стран
